name: Wipro Ltd
about: Wipro Ltd is a global Information technology, consulting and business process services (BPS) company.[1] It is the 4th largest Indian player in the global IT services industry behind TCS, Infosys and HCL Technologies.[2]
pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 5.92%.
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 46.7%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 8.38% over past five years.

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Newspaper Publication 19 Nov - Newspaper advertisement regarding mandatory transfer of equity shares of the Company to Investor Education and Protection Fund
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS 18 Nov
Change In Address Of Registrar And Share Transfer Agent 18 Nov - KFin Technologies, Wipro’s RTA, will relocate office effective December 1, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation 17 Nov - Analyst/institutional investor non-deal roadshow rescheduled to November 20, 2026 in Mumbai.

Intimation Of Cancellation Of Analyst / Institutional Investor Meeting Under The SEBI (LODR), Regulations, 2015 16 Nov - Wipro cancelled its November 19, 2026 non-deal roadshow in Mumbai; next date pending.
